rule: Names: second-order letter chain (next letter from counts keyed by the previous two letters, built from a word list), accepted only with minimum length and a vowel, up to 10 tries per length check, restart when over max length. Used for player names (4-8), artefact words, and scroll titles (2-8 letters per word, filled to 24 characters, duplicates re-rolled). Artefact name: quoted (1 in 3) or 'of Word'. Pit selection: for each pit of the wanted room type, offset = Normal(average, 10), keep the one closest to depth that passes a one-in-rarity gate. Pit build: draw 16 species at level cap depth+10 (any failure means no pit), sort by level, keep every other (8 tiers), leader = tier 7 at the centre, tiers placed in rings from the rim (tier 0 weakest). Out-of-depth: one in 25 raises the level cap by min(cap/4+2, 10). Profile pick: one pass, each eligible profile takes over with chance alloc divided by running total (reservoir sampling). Room template glyphs: x wall 50 percent, ^ trap 25 percent, 8 treasure 80 percent or stairs 20 percent.
